anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS format, which is the format used by this dataset (BIDS Version 1.9.0).

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: The paper describes the EEG-BIDS standard, which is the data organization standard used by this dataset (BIDS Version 1.9.0).

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 256 Hz sampling rate using 16 channels in standard 1020 montage with g.USBamp hardware (g.tec). The P300 paradigm employed a 9x8 character grid with visual stimulus presentation. Subjects performed 2 sessions each, with target and non-target event classifications. HED 8.4.0 event annotations were applied to classify sensory and experimental stimulus events.
